issues.summary: v26.7.3: Ecosystem Maturity & Conformance Completeness
issues.description:
Epic for claude-code-config-lsp v26.7.3 release. Advances the LSP validator from CANDIDATE to production-ready configuration law enforcement and conformance oracle for Claude Code.

Strategic pillars:
1. Ecosystem Maturation — Complete integration with wasm4pm-compat, OCEL event logging, and Chicago TDD patterns
2. Conformance Completeness — Expand Declare constraint coverage, add receipt chain persistence, and enable workspace health scoring
3. Developer Experience — Ship marketplace-ready plugin, skill-based validation API, and multi-workspace diagnostics

Target Release: 2026-09-20
Status: CANDIDATE (Receipt Chain OPEN)

issues.description:

Implement persistent OCEL 2.0 event logging to disk.

Current State:
- OcelAccumulator collects events in memory; events are never persisted

Goals:
- Write OCEL 2.0 events to disk in structured log format
- Monthly log rotation (YYYY-MM-OCEL.jsonl)
- Event types: file_opened, diagnostics_published, conformance_scored, receipt_issued
- At least 50 events recorded per typical agent session
- Each event valid against OCEL 2.0 JSON schema
- Log file size < 1 MB per month (average workspace)
- Enable via feature flag ocel-persistence (default: disabled)

Deliverable:
- OcelPersister struct writing events to ~/.claude/logs/claude-code-config-lsp/ocel-*.jsonl
- Include timestamps (UTC), URIs, event type, and severity counts
- Rotate logs monthly

Dependencies: chrono (existing), serde_json (existing)

Blockers: None

issues.summary: [M1] Receipt Chain Foundation
issues.description:
P0: Ecosystem Maturity

Create immutable receipt chain for each workspace snapshot.

Current State:
- Conformance scores are ephemeral; no audit trail

Goals:
- Issue receipt after each workspace scan
- Receipt includes: workspace ID, timestamp, conformance score, diagnostic checksums, signer
- Compute receipt hash: blake3(workspace_id + timestamp + score + checksums)
- Validate receipt chain: each receipt references prior receipt's hash (Merkle chain)
- Store receipts in ~/.claude/receipts/ with immutable semantics
- Receipt issued after each textDocument/publishDiagnostics batch
- Chain integrity verified on startup (detect tampering)
- Receipt available via URI query within 100ms

Deliverable:
- Receipt struct with hash computation
- Receipt chain validation logic
- Virtual URI: claude-config://receipts/<receipt-hash>
- Storage and retrieval from ~/.claude/receipts/

Dependencies: blake3 (existing), existing Backend infrastructure

Blockers: None

issues.summary: [M2] Conformance Scoring Refinement
issues.description:
P1: Conformance Completeness

Nuanced scoring that reflects severity and category.

Current State:
- Conformance score is (100 - 10*errors - 3*warnings); no weighting

Goals:
- Per-category weights: critical (settings perms) = 15pts, important (schema) = 5pts, minor (style) = 1pt
- Distinguish workspace score (global + all projects) vs. project score (local scope)
- Implement ConformanceVector (Declare-inspired): maps (surface_type, severity) → impact
- Publish conformance vector via claude-config://health (JSON)
- Add conformance trend tracking (over time)
- v26.6 workspace that scores 85 now scores 80–90 (weighted model gives finer granularity)
- Conformance queries include time-series data (past 7 days)

Deliverable:
- ConformanceVector struct
- Weighted scoring algorithm
- Virtual URI: claude-config://health
- Trend tracking and time-series data

Blockers: None

issues.summary: Implement ConformanceVector and weighted scoring
issues.description:
Task: Create ConformanceVector struct and weighted scoring algorithm.

Acceptance Criteria:
- ConformanceVector maps (surface_type, severity) → impact score
- Weight mapping:
  - Critical (settings permissions): 15 pts
  - Important (schema violations): 5 pts
  - Minor (style/lint): 1 pt
- Score computed as: base_score - sum(impact_scores) (clamped to [0, 100])
- Distinguish workspace vs. project score
- Workspace score = global score + min(all project scores) (conservative)
- Project score = only local scope diagnostics

Implementation:
- Add src/conformance_vector.rs
- Create ConformanceVector struct
- Implement compute_score() function
- Add to Backend and invoke after diagnostics

Done:
- Unit test: test_conformance_vector_weighted_scoring
- Test case: v26.6 score 85 → v26.7.3 score 80-90 (verify range)
- Regression test: existing tests still pass
